name: Nick Cano
biography: Nick is a self-taught software engineer, hacker, and an avid CTFer. He started coding when he was 11 and planted his roots in video game hacking by 14. His game hacking endeavors lead to a profitable business which became the foothold for his career. Nick is the author of"Game Hacking: Developing Autonomous Bots for Online Games," and has spoken about topics such as malware analysis, Windows internals, game hacking, and memory forensics at DEF CON, DerbyCon, HOPE, and other prestigious conferences. Previously a Senior Engineer at Bromium and currently a Senior Architect at Cylance, he's using his Windows internals experience to help make advances with endpoint protection, detection, and response. https://twitter.com/nickcano93, https://nickcano.com/, https://github.com/nickcano
